Drag this canister from your cargo on to the skill bar and get close to the Whomp-Ass.
Once you're within 15m of the Whomp-Ass fire off the Gas Canister like you would a clickable item.

You have collected the Whomp-Ass Gas Canister.  This is a useable item, much like a health kit and can be found in your normal cargo area, not your mission cargo area.  

To use the gas on the Whomp-Ass, find the Gas Canister in your cargo and drag it to an empty slot in your skill bar at the bottom of your screen.  Then, get close to the Whomp-Ass - within 15m - and click on the Gas Canister in your skill bar to release the gas.  You can also right click on the Gas Canister in your inventory to set it off.
